devils_advocate_risks: Traditional industrial buyers may be slow to adopt new emissions calculation software.
It is unknown how well the software scales across different industrial processes.
next_step: HTGF Industrial Tech team: Ask the founders which industrial processes, if any, paying customers already use Zelsius to calculate emissions for.
one_liner: Zelsius develops emissions calculation software for Swiss industry and gained ETH Zurich spin-off recognition in 2026.
team: The founder records list Adina Hochuli (Managing Director), Yannick Krabben (Head of Product Development), Lukas Hegner (Head of Research & Development), and Marcel Niederberger (Head of Marketing & Sales).

top_signals.signal: ETH Zurich lists Zelsius on its 2026 spin-off roster.
Zelsius received approximately CHF 15,000 from the Energy Lab in May 2023 and secured a Gerbert Rüf Stiftung grant in November 2023.
